title: Shirin ribar ku na shafi ɗaya, canjin farashi da bita na wata-wata

say: Shirin ribar ku na shafi ɗaya, canjin farashi, da bita na wata-wata.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don Module 4 na Farashi, Tsara da Tsare-tsaren Riba.
A cikin wannan tsari na ƙarshe, komai yana haɗuwa a shafi ɗaya, tare da kowane lamba tare da sauran. Na farko, teburin kuɗin ku da farashin naúrar ku.

say: Ga kasuwancin sabis. Kayyade kudin Halima ciki har da albashinta na Naira 70,000, Naira dubu 155 ne duk wata.
Kowace riga tana amfani da kayan naira 4,400, don haka gudummawar ta naira 10,600.
155,000 da aka raba ta 10,600 shine 14.6. Don haka ta karya ko da a riguna 15, kuma tana buqatar riguna 23 don ta kai mata Naira 80,000. Ta shirya 25, akan naira 375,000 na siyarwa.
A kwashi kayan naira 110,000 da kuma naira 155,000 na tsayayyen farashi.
Ribar da za ta samu ya kai Naira 110,000, kuma ba za ta iya ba.
Tana karbar kashi 50 cikin 100 na Naira 7,500, wanda ya kunshi kayan, don haka ba ta taba ba da su daga aljihunta ba.

Duba shirin ku. Kowane ƙayyadadden farashi yana bayyana sau ɗaya, gami da ladan ku. Ana amfani da farashi iri ɗaya a ko'ina. An tattara Break-ko da manufa, kuma duka biyun suna ƙasa da abin da za ku iya samarwa.
Bayanan kuɗin ku sun faɗi yadda za ku ba da kuɗin kayan, kuma kowane farashi yana da kwanan wata.

say: Rangwame yana fitowa kai tsaye daga gudummawar ku.
Ngozi na samun gudummawar naira 760 a kowace fakiti, naira 152,000 a wata.
A kashi 10 cikin 100, farashin ya kai naira 1,530, sannan gudunmawar ta fado zuwa naira 590. Za ta buƙaci fakiti 258, ƙarin tallace-tallace kashi 29, don kawai ta tsaya cak.
Don haka sai ta ba da bundigu: fakiti 5 akan naira 8,000, wanda har yanzu ana samun naira 660 a fakitin.
Idan gari ya tashi daga naira 15,000 zuwa 18,000, Ngozi ta sake kirgawa. Wato Naira 60 ya fi kowacce fakiti, don haka farashinta ya zama naira 1,000.

say: Ta tunatar da su har yanzu sabo ne, a rufe da cikakken nauyi, kuma ta gode musu.
Kar a taɓa rage nauyi a hankali. Abokan ciniki suna lura, kuma rashin gaskiya ne.

panel.rule: Kada a taɓa rage nauyi kuma kiyaye lakabi iri ɗaya da farashi.

say: Yi amfani da dabara ɗaya: riba tana daidai da gudunmawar lokutan sayar da raka'a a kowace naúra, ban da ƙayyadaddun farashi. Canja lamba ɗaya a lokaci guda.

say: Ribar Ngozi sau 250 sau 760, ya rage 110,000. Naira 80,000 kenan.

card.title: Gwada yanke shawara akan takarda da farko

say: Tashin farashin Naira 100 ya daga riba zuwa Naira 105,000.

card.title: Gwada yanke shawara akan takarda da farko

say: Kashi 10 cikin 100 na farashin canji ya ragu zuwa naira 56,500. Kuma faduwar kashi 20 cikin 100 na tallace-tallace ya ragu zuwa Naira 42,000.
Don haka kare farashi da girma ya fi dacewa, kuma hauhawar farashin dole ne a wuce da sauri.

card.title: Gwada yanke shawara akan takarda da farko

say: Don tunawa. Ci gaba da shirin ku a shafi ɗaya, tare da kowane lamba yarda. Rike maƙasudi cikin iyawar ku. Ƙara ƙima maimakon yanke farashi. Lokacin da farashin ya tashi, sake ƙididdigewa da farko, sannan ba da sanarwa. Kuma duba lambobin ku kowane wata.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Shafi ɗaya, kuma kowane lamba ya yarda
Karya-ko da kuma niyya ƙasa da ƙarfin ku
Daure suna kare farashin ku fiye da yankewa
Lokacin da farashi ya tashi, sake ƙididdigewa, sannan ba da sanarwa
Yi bitar P&L, farashi, tsabar kuɗi da manufa kowane wata

say: Yanzu tsara tsarin ribar ku mai shafi ɗaya tare da lambobinku na gaske, shirya bayanan ƙimar ku da saƙon canjin farashi, sannan gudanar da bita na farko na wata-wata tare da abubuwa uku-idan yanayi.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
